text:
jess (Account Exec): heads-up 1: MeridianHealth has a sudden platform usage dip after a feature rollout. they asked if we can do a temporary token-rate concession + a small onboarding credit so they don't pause the Dedicated instance. asking finance for a one-off approval.
sam (Sales Ops): quick facts: committed monthly tokens = 300M, expected drop to ~160M for ~4 months while they finish integration. legal said amendment ok. customer requests rate change on incremental usage only.
jess (Account Exec): proposed offer: $9,750 one-time onboarding credit + reduce incremental per-token rate from $0.0035 -> $0.0025 for 4 months (applies only above committed floor). routing to finance for approval and GL guidance. tagging @tara
tara (Finance): need an estimate of revenue impact and confirmation this is temporary. also need GL account and whether credit should be amortized. any similar precedent?
sam (Sales Ops): precedent: short-term concession for Nimbus pilot (see ref 2312347654) but that had different sizing. this is temporary only; we will auto-revert rate at end date.
mike (RevOps): please provide delta calc and attach SFDC opp & amended order before we push to billing. i'll log an OPS ticket for the override.
jess (Account Exec): calc below (rounded):
```
current_rate = 0.0035
proposed_rate = 0.0025
committed_floor = 300,000,000
expected_tokens_during_reduction = 160,000,000
delta = current_rate - proposed_rate # 0.0010
monthly_savings_customer = delta * expected_tokens_during_reduction
monthly_savings_customer = 0.0010 * 160,000,000 = $160,000
4_month_savings = $640,000
one_time_credit = $9,750
approx_revenue_loss_over_4mo = $649,750
note: applies only to incremental usage; if monthly incremental is zero, no change.
```
sam (Sales Ops): confirm: committed floor unchanged; amendment language to limit concession to usage over floor.
tara (Finance): ok the math is clear. request exact amendment clause "incremental usage above committed floor billed at adjusted rate" before final sign-off. GL: use promo-credits-2026-NE for the $9,750. amortize credit over 2 months for ARR recognition.
mike (RevOps): creating Jira ticket OPS-8012 to implement temporary rate override and track attachments. will not apply until amendment signed + GL confirmed.
(jess uploads draft amendment to SFDC: https://sales.redwood/opp/MH-9012 - internal)
amendment-bot: Reminder: amendment must include auto-revert clause and effective dates. suggested window: 2026-06-01 -> 2026-09-30.
tara (Finance): decision: CONDITIONAL APPROVAL. Approve $9,750 onboarding credit (GL promo-credits-2026-NE, amortize over 2 months) and temporary incremental rate 0.0025 for a 4-month window provided: 1) signed amendment with exact "incremental-only" language, 2) SFDC opp updated with amended order form, 3) OPS-8012 has amendment attached. Finance will issue final go-ahead in Jira once conditions met. :white_check_mark:
jess (Account Exec): thanks 1: i'll get legal to sign and will drop the signed pdf on OPS-8012 + SFDC. will follow up when done.
mike (RevOps): noted. OPS-8012 created and will be updated when assets are attached.
sam (Sales Ops): tagging this thread for audit. thanks all. :lock:
